scripts.//prepare: dist/ is gitignored but `main` points at it, so a clean checkout has no runtime entry point and any consumer importing a VALUE (not just `import type`, which bundlers erase) fails to resolve the package. Bit Dockerfile.web (#217), Dockerfile.api (#309) and EAS Build. `prepare` fixes it at the source, for every consumer, at install time. The existsSync guard is required: Docker deps stages copy ONLY the package.json files and install before copying source, so tsconfig.build.json is absent and a bare `pnpm build` fails TS5058 and kills the image build. Both Dockerfiles already build this package explicitly after copying source, so skipping there costs nothing. Written inline rather than as a script file because a script file is not copied into those deps stages either.
scripts.prepare: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(!f.existsSync('tsconfig.build.json')||!f.existsSync('src/index.ts')){console.log('[@libertasian/types] prepare: sources absent (dependency-only install) - skipping build');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('pnpm build',{stdio:'inherit'})"
